title: Operating Lines of Credit — Product Entry Standards and Commitment Bands
content:
Cottonwood Plains Farm Credit offers six Operating Lines of Credit, ranked from the StartRight Operating Line (rank 1) to the Agribusiness Revolving Line (rank 6). Each product has its own entry standard and its own commitment band.

## Entry standards by product

| Rank | Product | Entry standard |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | StartRight Operating Line | Young, beginning and small farmer program; the applicant is at most 35 years of age or has farmed at most 10 years; gross farm sales of no more than USD 350,000; a farm business plan is required; commitment of no more than USD 150,000 |
| 2 | ExpressLine Operating Credit | Credit score of at least 690; at least 3 years farming; commitment of no more than USD 300,000; no financial statement required |
| 3 | Seasonal Operating Loan | At least 2 years farming; a crop or production plan is required; crop insurance is required; commitment of no more than USD 2,500,000 |
| 4 | Revolving Operating Line | At least 3 years farming; current ratio of at least 1.25; working capital of at least 20% of expenses; commitment of no more than USD 5,000,000 |
| 5 | Borrowing Base Operating Line | Commitment of at least USD 750,000; current ratio of at least 1.15; a monthly borrowing base certificate; commitment of no more than USD 25,000,000 |
| 6 | Agribusiness Revolving Line | Primary segment agribusiness; annual revenue of at least USD 5,000,000; reviewed or audited financial statements; commitment of at least USD 1,000,000 and no more than USD 40,000,000 |

For the StartRight Operating Line the age test and the years-farming test are alternatives: either one satisfies that part of the standard.

## Commitment band and seasonal loan allowance

- **Smallest commitment**: the smallest commitment the product is booked for, in USD.
- **Largest commitment**: the largest commitment the product is booked for, in USD; it is also the ceiling for any renewal or mid-term increase.
- **Seasonal loans per crop year**: the number of Seasonal Operating Loans a member may hold for the same crop year alongside any revolving line.

| Product | Smallest commitment (USD) | Largest commitment (USD) | Seasonal Operating Loans per crop year |
|---|---|---|---|
| StartRight Operating Line | 10,000.00 (10000) | 150,000.00 (150000) | 2 |
| ExpressLine Operating Credit | 25,000.00 (25000) | 300,000.00 (300000) | 2 |
| Seasonal Operating Loan | 25,000.00 (25000) | 2,500,000.00 (2500000) | 2 |
| Revolving Operating Line | 100,000.00 (100000) | 5,000,000.00 (5000000) | 2 |
| Borrowing Base Operating Line | 750,000.00 (750000) | 25,000,000.00 (25000000) | 2 |
| Agribusiness Revolving Line | 1,000,000.00 (1000000) | 40,000,000.00 (40000000) | 2 |

## Reading the band

A commitment equal to the smallest or the largest figure lies within the band. Because the largest commitment is also the ceiling for renewals and mid-term increases, a Revolving Operating Line can never be renewed or increased to more than USD 5,000,000, whatever the member asks for.

*Hypothetical illustration:* a request for an ExpressLine Operating Credit of USD 300,000 is at the top of that product's band; a request for USD 300,001 on the same product lies above it.
